Visioner BIG | 🇩🇪 🇺🇦 🇷🇺 ‼️ ‼️ German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has warned that Vladimir Putin’s ambitions extend far beyond Ukraine, accusing Russia of escalating tensions across Europe and declaring that supporting Kyiv is essential to Europe’s own security. Merz criticized both the far right and far left for failing to recognize the scale of the Russian threat. He accused Moscow of escalating its activities in the Baltic region, Poland, the Black Sea, space, and Germany itself, including actions that have put human lives at risk. He stressed that Europe must establish clear limits on Russian aggression and pointed to the unity demonstrated at last Thursday’s Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin. According to Merz, even American representatives appeared surprised by the strength of European cooperation. He said this unity provides grounds for cautious optimism about achieving a genuine peace. Merz’s remarks reflect a growing European focus on the wider security implications of Russia’s war against Ukraine. His message is that the conflict is not only about Ukrainian territory but also about the future security of Europe. By maintaining military support for Kyiv and strengthening cooperation among European states, Germany aims to reinforce deterrence and reduce the risk of further Russian escalation beyond Ukraine. Africa needs nearly $1.6 billion to combat Ebola from November 2026 to May 2027, according to a joint action plan drawn up by the Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and the World Health Organization. The plan, published on the Africa CDC website, calls for stronger disease surveillance, earlier detection of cases, greater capacity at health facilities, preventive measures and closer cross-border cooperation. The current outbreak is the largest on record caused by the Bundibugyo virus, according to the plan. The Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the epicenter, with more than 11,700 confirmed cases and over 5,700 deaths . The case fatality rate is 48.9%. The disease has been detected in eight provinces, with Ituri and North Kivu hit the hardest.
